name: Quattroporte I
description: The original Maserati Quattroporte (1963–1970) was the world's first genuine high-performance luxury saloon. Designed by Pietro Frua with a 4.1-litre V8 capable of 230 hp, it could carry four people in elegance at over 230 km/h — a concept entirely new to the automotive world.
